description: Edge zones on the j faces of the blocks (B 521 edges 3 and 4 with B 522): a Riemann edge with a 5 mm tide on the +j face of block 1 (x = 0), a Flather edge on the -j face of block 2 (x = 14.4); the blocks are turned and cut into pieces on two ranks (G 55 2). The same solution as the faces on -i / +i of the whole blocks (3e-14 m, validation 06_turned_blocks).
covers: B 522 on the j faces (bc_zone, reefamr::blocks_open)
